Bold sits in the courage family (VR04_SYNONYM_GROUPS courage: brave, bold, daring), and 'calm in the face of danger' is how a child is taught to describe a brave person. A child could defend 'calm' (unafraid, cool-headed) as nearer to bold than 'stubborn'. (3) The vr04-one-feature-only story is fitted, the same fault as the refused 'shouting'. Boldness shows in taking a risk, not in staying calm. A bold act is often excited or hasty, so calm is not a sign of boldness. Needs a word that is a true single visible sign of boldness, correct in no sense (brave, cheeky, bright/vivid, thick print), and not on VR04_NEVER_ADD or forbiddenFor('bold').
